constraints.sourceName: Parks Canada — Banff National Park, Lake Louise and Moraine Lake access
constraints.travellerNote: Personal vehicles are not admitted on the Moraine Lake road in season; the way in is the Parks Canada shuttle, a commercial operator or a licensed taxi, and shuttle seats are reserved ahead.
constraints.alternative: Lake Louise itself is reachable by the same shuttle system, and the Icefields Parkway viewpoints need no reservation.

constraints.sourceName: Parks Canada — Banff National Park shuttle reservations
constraints.travellerNote: Lakeshore parking at Lake Louise fills before dawn in season; the shuttle from the park-and-ride is the reliable way in and is booked in advance.

constraints.sourceName: Parks Canada — Jasper National Park important bulletins
constraints.travellerNote: Maligne Canyon is closed for the 2026 season while the trail and its bridges are rebuilt.
constraints.alternative: Sunwapta Falls and Athabasca Falls are open and give the same canyon-and-water day on the way south.

constraints.sourceName: Parks Canada — park entry fees and passes
constraints.travellerNote: A Parks Canada day or annual pass has to be displayed in the windscreen anywhere inside the mountain parks.
